title: State of the Trenches, 2026-W43: fees −8.4% week over week
dek: Launchpad fees were $22.33M across 14 non-overlapping venues and creator earnings $11.15M; Perpetual-futures coins led narrative volume.

body.text: The covered launchpad fee subtotal for 2026-W43 (Oct 19, 2026 to Oct 25, 2026, UTC) was $22.33M across 14 non-overlapping venues, −8.4% against 2026-W42 on the same venues. 5 venues that share a fee stream with another venue are reported individually and never added.
Creator earnings — fees paid to coin creators and, depending on the venue's own definition, holders, referrers or traders — were $11.15M across 16 venues that define them, −9.5% week over week.
By share of the subtotal, pump.fun gained the most (+3.5 points) and Flap.sh lost the most (-1.7 points). A share shift says where fees moved, not why.

Trading in the coins of the tracked narratives totalled $506.95M for the week, counting a coin once when it belongs to more than one narrative (the per-narrative totals add up to $529.1M). This is the volume of identified coins across their indexed pools, not of the whole market.

Perpetual-futures coins carried the most volume among narratives collected during the week: $248.25M (partial: some member-days were not observed). Its week-over-week change is withheld: 0 of 6 members present in both weeks were fully observed in both, below the comparable-basket minimum.

First observed this week: GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins, Kimchi coins, PHP2Shell coins, AI inference market coins, French protest coins, Pump.fun card-gacha coins. A narrative's first week has no meaningful prior week, so no change is reported for it.

Collection paused during the week: Kimchi coins, French protest coins, Flying Tesla Roadster coins, AI influencer characters, Creator fees routed to people. Their members stay members; their totals after the pause are partial, not zero.
